topic: Social media algorithms and psychological manipulation
motion: Social media platforms use sophisticated algorithms to deliberately manipulate user psychology and political beliefs for profit and control.

CA.what_changes_mind: Demonstrable evidence of platforms consistently prioritizing user well-being over engagement, even when it impacts revenue. A clear articulation of how the current business model can be fundamentally altered to incentivize ethical behavior.

SA.what_changes_mind: Evidence showing platforms voluntarily adopting more aggressive and costly interventions for harm reduction, even at the expense of short-term profits.
